summary: TikZ reconstruction compiles and passes topology checks. Best version is v1 (Critic score 0.92): full circle centred at O (radius 157 px) through A, B, C, D; diameter AB with O at its midpoint; solid chords DB, CB and DC; labels A, B, C, D, O all correct. The Critic confirmed the render matches the original. v2 (centre dot enlarged to 2.8pt) scored 0.91 and is not the best version. Its only remaining low-severity note is that the centre dot at O is still slightly smaller than in the original.
